title: CelestialPhysicalCatalog
description: Source-preserving physical catalog, separate from physical gameplay estimates. Curated values are game-grade catalog approximations, HYG stellar mass/radius are spectral estimates, procedural planet values are generated, and mission values are estimates, not uniformly measured data. Scalar display-radius precedence: first positive finite meanRadiusKm, equatorialRadiusKm, radiusKm, estimatedDiameterM/2000, then physical.estimatedDiameterM/2000; otherwise unknown. Mass precedence: first positive finite massKg, estimatedMassKg, then physical.estimatedMassKg; otherwise unknown. This is consumer selection guidance, not a backend conversion or overwrite. Zero is not evidence of a measured zero size or mass. Never merge the two provenance objects.

massKg.description: Catalog mass in kg; source may be an approximation.

meanRadiusKm.description: Mean radius in km; preferred scalar representation over equatorial radius.

equatorialRadiusKm.description: Equatorial radius in km; may differ from mean radius.

estimatedDiameterM.description: Estimated diameter in metres; divide by 2000 for radius in km.

estimatedMassKg.description: Estimated mass in kg, not a measured mass.

rotationPeriodSec.description: Rotation period in seconds; source sign conventions retained.

surfaceGravityMps2.description: Surface gravity in metres per second squared.
